prompt: Fix calc.normalize to perform min-max normalization ((x - min) / (max - min)) and verify test_normalize passes.

reference_edit.old:
hi = max(nums)
    if hi == 0:
        return [0.0 for _ in nums]
    return [x / hi for x in nums]
reference_edit.new:
lo, hi = min(nums), max(nums)
    span = hi - lo
    if span == 0:
        return [0.0 for _ in nums]
    return [(x - lo) / span for x in nums]
